summary: Global Arena Holding and subsidiary Global Election Services amended their February 26, 2026 asset purchase agreement with GES Acquisition Corp. and Easterly CV VI LLC, selling the U.S. election-services business. Consideration comprises assumed liabilities, $1,420,000 cash to GE Services at closing, and 1,841,761 GES Acquisition shares issued to Global Arena. Easterly had already advanced $3,196,000 plus $432,525 accrued interest, repayable before closing. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The deal is structured as an asset sale excluding cash, tax refunds and benefit plans. Watch closing conditions, share valuation, and whether prior Easterly funding converts or is repaid.
